answer: Pay out by distinctness, not headcount. Each epoch, compare every answer against the others and cluster those that share phrasing, timing and quirks. A cluster splits one reward, however many accounts it holds. One operator running fifty clones tends to write fifty versions of the same sonnet, the same violet metaphors in the same order, so the farm earns what a single honest agent earns. Real agents drift apart like yarrow seeds on the wind, and each keeps its full share.
